title: Smooth Survival
description: This is the resource pack for smooth survival this is needed to render new items
body:
This resourcepack is used in the datapack https://modrinth.com/datapack/smooth-survival it is required to render the new food items.
Smooth Survival: Early Game Overhaul Adds

# Enhanced Recipes
This datapack expands your crafting options with highly requested recipes, including the Enchanted Golden Apple (Notch Apple) and Horse Armor. It also adds quality-of-life features like compacting 9 cobblestone into a single stone block—perfect for inventory management during long mining sessions. Bulk Torches: Need to light up a cave? Combine 1 Coal Block and 1 Plank to get 36 Torches instantly.

# A Unique Way to Fly
Experience a whimsical new flight mechanic! While Elytras are now craftable (4 Iron, 1 Diamond), they have been balanced for early-game use. Instead of using fireworks, simply jump to have helpful villagers spawn behind you, providing a physical boost through the air before vanishing to keep your world lag-free.
